handoff.summary: TENANT-01 menutup cross-tenant admin object checks dan memperbaiki runtime role dev. Portal browser kini menampilkan Histori tenant-scoped dan realtime Live tersambung.
handoff.next_action: Lanjutkan PILOT-01 sesuai environment gate; development browser sudah dapat dipakai untuk uji manual tenant-scoped.

tasks.title: Finalisasi baseline planning
acceptance: Baseline v1.0, keputusan dan batas validasi tersedia; bukan klaim kode selesai.
Planning terhubung di indeks, JSON contoh dan link lokal diperiksa.

tasks.title: AGENTS, skill lokal dan tracker progres
acceptance: AGENTS.md, delapan skill repo dan coverage semua planning tersedia; tidak ada instalasi global.
Tracker validate/render/status/next, validator skills dan negative tests tracker lulus.
Backlog memisahkan planning selesai dari implementasi yang belum dimulai.

tasks.title: Scaffold workspace Rust dan health
acceptance: Cargo workspace apps/server dan crates sesuai baseline; config typed dan secret redaction.
healthz/readyz, graceful shutdown, fmt/clippy/build/test tersedia dan lulus.

tasks.title: Scaffold portal dan tooling frontend
acceptance: React/Vite TS strict, Tailwind/shadcn, pnpm lockfile dan scripts lint/typecheck/test/build tersedia.
Shell dengan route/loading/error, dev API/WS proxy; belum mengklaim fitur auth selesai.

tasks.title: Environment lokal dan CI dasar
acceptance: Compose disposable PG/PostGIS/Mailpit dan sample env tanpa secret; dokumentasi perintah.
CI build/lint/typecheck dan unit tests backend/frontend, dependency versions pinned.

tasks.title: OpenAPI tracking lengkap
acceptance: Semua route tracking/heartbeat, fields tenant/status dan errors tercakup OpenAPI 3.1.
Contoh valid terhadap schema; idempotency/header auth/limit/pagination eksplisit.

tasks.title: OpenAPI management dan schema WS
acceptance: Auth/MFA/challenges, invite/platform/grants/token/audit routes tercakup.
Schema event/subscription/ticket WS eksplisit termasuk observed_at dan access rules.

tasks.title: Generate client dan CI contract checks
acceptance: TS types/openapi-fetch client dihasilkan dari kontrak dan dapat dipakai portal.
CI validation/example/generated diff check mencegah drift; tidak hand-edit generated output.

tasks.title: Migrasi identity, tenant dan auth
acceptance: Tables identity/membership/auth/factors/token/outbox dan constraint uniqueness diterapkan.
Migration fresh/upgrade, atomic token/code consumption dan missing tenant tests lulus.

tasks.title: Migrasi domain, positions dan locking
acceptance: Targets/devices/session/positions/credentials/idempotency/audit termasuk tenant composite FKs dan indexes.
Active-session uniqueness/exclusion, canonical-year expiry dan lock order diuji concurrency.

tasks.title: RLS dan repositories tenant-scoped
acceptance: Non-owner FORCE RLS, SET LOCAL context, token lookup sempit dan worker role diterapkan.
Cross-tenant FK/read/write, missing context, pool reuse, owner bypass tests lulus pada PostgreSQL.

tasks.title: Password login, cookie sesi dan CSRF
acceptance: Argon2id, strict limited challenges, cookie flags, idle/absolute expiry dan CSRF/Origin diterapkan.
Wrong password/principal, login CSRF, timeout/logout/session revoke dan no secret logging diuji.

tasks.title: TOTP enrollment dan recovery
acceptance: TOTP encrypted secret, replay-step guard, mandatory MFA dan pending_mfa flow diterapkan.
Concurrent code replay/recovery, password-only bypass, recent auth dan recovery re-enrollment tests lulus.

tasks.title: Email reset/aktivasi dan bootstrap CLI
acceptance: SMTP outbox/Mailpit, expiring one-use links, reset preserving MFA dan CLI bootstrap/operator recovery.
Link scanner/replay/expiry, matching existing account, secret redaction dan failed-email recovery diuji.

tasks.title: Organisasi dan invitation lifecycle
acceptance: Platform create/suspend/reactivate, invite accept/resend/revoke dan metadata endpoints selesai.
Platform tidak mendapat koordinat; org suspend memblokir request, pending admin enrollment dan invite mismatch diuji.

tasks.title: Membership, grant dan peran
acceptance: Role/grant checks, creator grants, last-admin lock dan request tenant per tab implemented.
Cross-tenant grant, viewer write, concurrent last-admin, perubahan grant dan integration-owner checks diuji.

Boolean MFA policy lookup recognizes active operator credentials:write grants without exposing tracking data; grant activation, revocation/downgrade, cross-tenant isolation and login policy are tested.

tasks.title: Portal login/onboarding dan organisasi
acceptance: Login/MFA/recovery, sessions list/revoke, undangan, anggota dan organisasi aktif terintegrasi API.
Auth-portal acceptance dan tenant switch multi-tab/late response tests lulus tanpa token persistence.

tasks.title: CRUD terbatas target/device
acceptance: Create/list/detail/PATCH sesuai schema, unique external_ref/identifier, grants creator dan filters.
No cross-tenant/read without grant, validation metadata/name, conflict/errors teruji.

tasks.title: Provisioning, rotasi dan disable device
acceptance: Secret sekali, one-active-token, recent MFA credential permission dan lifecycle enable/re-enable.
Rotation/disable concurrent ingestion serialization, old token reject, viewer/operator permission tests lulus.

tasks.title: Struktur modul server dan pemisahan test
acceptance: Konvensi struktur folder source, domain dan test didokumentasikan sebagai panduan refactor bertahap.
Handler target/device dan test server dipisah dari lib.rs tanpa mengubah route atau perilaku API.
Workspace Rust diformat, lulus clippy dan seluruh test yang dapat dijalankan; bukti mencatat test yang memerlukan PostgreSQL bila tidak tersedia.

tasks.title: Application tokens dan audit query
acceptance: Tenant/owner-scoped limited integration tokens, expiry/revoke dan admin metadata/audit endpoints.
Tidak bisa menerbitkan credential/manage accounts, owner permission recheck, audit redaction diuji.

tasks.title: Tracking session lifecycle
acceptance: Create/list/detail/end, wajib Idempotency-Key dan auth replay, server clocks setelah lock.
AC-01/02/10/12, overlaps, concurrent end dan boundaries termasuk zero-duration lulus.

tasks.title: HTTP ingestion dan canonical validation
acceptance: Batch/schema/measurements/message hash, session_only/always, late/future retry serta transaction atomicity.
AC-03/04/05/06/08, DB failure no stored, duplicate/conflict races dan wrong-device token lulus.

tasks.title: Latest/history repositories dan expiry
acceptance: Temporal history, deterministic sort/cursor, latest target/device terpisah dan expiry filter.
AC-07, out-of-order/tie IDs, previous-session visibility, cursor tenant/filter mismatch dan calendar expiry lulus.

tasks.title: Heartbeat dan status terpisah
acceptance: Heartbeat tanpa koordinat/sesi, monotonic contact, 60/180 dan freshness terpisah.
AC-13/14, idle/stale-online/no_position/unknown, rejected batch contact dan disabled device tests.

tasks.title: WS ticket, subscriptions dan timeout
acceptance: Single-use ticket session/tenant binding, Origin, subscriptions replace atomik, queue bound dan worker timeout.
Cross-tenant/unauthorized ID, revocation open WS, expired auth, reconnect/restart serta slow consumer diuji.

tasks.title: Rekonsiliasi event dan snapshot
acceptance: Post-commit events, target projection dan observed_at/position ordering sesuai schema.
AC-09/11, duplicate no event, snapshot race, target reassignment dan backfill event tests lulus.

tasks.title: Halaman target/device/token/session
acceptance: Management UI menggunakan effective grants pengguna untuk kontrol create/write/credential/session per organisasi dan objek; token sekali tampil, active-session requirements dan lifecycle controls tetap diikuti.

Bagian provisioning/session AC-PORT-01/02/03/04/09, error/conflict/empty states dan API-direct negative permission tested. Verifikasi map dan histori end-to-end AC-PORT-01/09 didelegasikan ke PORTAL-02/03.

tasks.title: Peta live dan status kontak
acceptance: MapLibre/MapTiler integration konfigurabel, attribution, current-session map dan separate status.
AC-PORT-01 live-position journey dan AC-PORT-05/07, provider failure fallback, tenant switch and stale marker behavior E2E diuji.

tasks.title: Histori, filter dan audit portal
acceptance: History device/session, timezone, cursor tables, cap map 10000 partial label dan audit admin.
AC-PORT-01 history journey dan AC-PORT-06/08/09, date boundaries/pagination/partial data, retained authorized history after device disable, no persisted coordinates diuji.

tasks.title: Purge retensi, audit dan logs
acceptance: Purge bounded/expiry reads, 365d audit/14d logs, outbox cleanup dan tombstone procedure.
Calendar/leap-year expiry, retry retention, purge failure alarm dan data deletion fixtures teruji.

tasks.title: Security limits dan observability
acceptance: Per-route rates, auth brute-force, CSP/headers, bounded WS/pool/query timeouts dan metrics.
No sensitive logs/labels, CSRF/replay and policy regression, CI dependency checks terverifikasi.

tasks.title: Backup/restore dan rollback drill
acceptance: pgBackRest full/incremental/WAL, encryption/keys runbook dan isolated restore.
Measured RPO/RTO, tombstone/expiry purge, dan invalidasi auth tersedia; runbook menetapkan syarat kompatibilitas rollback.

tasks.title: Load dan E2E release readiness
acceptance: Synthetic 100-device steady/burst/heartbeat/backfill, documented environment/seed/timings/storage forecast.
Semua AC P0, auth/tenant/concurrency/portal tests lulus; audit evidence bukan hanya checklist.

tasks.title: Image dan deployment preflight
acceptance: Multi-stage image static/Rust, Caddy TLS routing, non-root, readiness/migration preflight dan rollback guide.
Local/staging smoke passes; daftar domain/SMTP/map/backup/host prerequisites terverifikasi tanpa secret evidence.

Sebelum pilot, uji image/build aplikasi sebelumnya terhadap schema hasil migration di staging: startup/readiness dan negative tenant-authorization smoke lulus; simpan digest kedua build dan hasilnya. Jika build sebelumnya belum pernah production, gunakan kandidat dari code state berurutan. Uji gagal/tidak tersedia berarti pilot tetap tertahan.
tasks.blocked_reason: Deployment commit 8e7e3f0, health/readiness, aktivasi/login, worker retention, restore dump terisolasi, dan startup/readiness API build sebelumnya sudah lulus. Request tenant ID tanpa session ditolak 403. Portal staging belum memiliki organisasi/device aktif sehingga authenticated cross-tenant dan map/history dengan data sintetis, serta pemeriksaan konfigurasi tile, belum dapat diselesaikan.
tasks.unblock_action: Siapkan data tenant sintetis yang diotorisasi (dua organisasi, membership terbatas, device/session/posisi sintetis), verifikasi akses tenant lintas organisasi ditolak serta peta/history staging bekerja, dan catat hasil tanpa menyimpan koordinat/token/secret di evidence. Setelah itu tinjau acceptance PILOT-01.

tasks.title: Pilot deployment terotorisasi
acceptance: Otorisasi deployment dan environment tersedia; real migration/health, tenant isolation dan provider connectivity smoke.
Backup/WAL monitoring aktif, production-safe rollback path dan deployment evidence; jangan mark done dari local mock.

tasks.title: Acceptance MVP dan handover
acceptance: Review semua required task/evidence dan pilot behavior, residual issue list tidak menyembunyikan P0.
Runbook/handover lengkap, STATUS menyatakan MVP hanya setelah semua required tasks done.

tasks.title: MQTT adapter
acceptance: Dirancang/dikerjakan hanya pada scope lanjutan yang diotorisasi.

tasks.title: Hardware binary adapters
acceptance: Pilih model/firmware/fixtures sebelum klaim dukungan.

tasks.title: Scale/WebAuthn/analytics
acceptance: Perubahan scope melalui revisi desain; tidak termasuk acceptance MVP.

tasks.title: Konfigurasi retensi posisi deployment
acceptance: POSITION_RETENTION_DAYS tervalidasi 1–36500, default 365, dan digunakan ingestion serta retention worker.
Expiry baru memakai konfigurasi; penurunan konfigurasi membuat worker purge row lama tanpa membuka akses payload lintas tenant.
Fresh/upgrade migration, default kalender, nilai 60 hari, purge/RLS dan regression tests lulus; dokumentasi .env dan operasi menjelaskan rollout.

tasks.title: Seed sintetis lokal untuk uji portal browser
acceptance: Seed hanya menerima localhost *_dev/*_test, memakai password tersembunyi/env dan Argon2id, menerapkan migration serta idempotent.
Akun admin lokal MFA-normal dan dua organisasi dengan target/device/session/position sintetis dapat dipakai di portal.
Disposable PostGIS memverifikasi migration, row counts dan rerun no-op; panduan browser tersedia.

tasks.title: Tutup akses admin lintas-tenant pada resource dan realtime
acceptance: Admin hanya mendapat izin untuk resource yang benar-benar dimiliki tenant yang dipilih; resource id tenant lain ditolak oleh REST dan WebSocket.
Daftar target/device tetap terikat tenant meskipun koneksi database memiliki BYPASSRLS; konfigurasi development memakai login runtime least-privilege, bukan user superuser.
Regression tests membuktikan daftar, location endpoint dan subscription tidak melintasi tenant; portal Histori dan Live berfungsi pada seed dua organisasi.
